name: Ecocomfort2
description: The `ecocomfort2` component lets you control a [Fantini Cosmi Aspirvelo Air Ecocomfort 2.0 Smart](https://www.fantinicosmi.it/prodotto/aspirvelo-air-ecocomfort-2-0-smart/) heat recovery ventilation unit over BLE from an ESP32.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often the operating state and the measurements are read from the unit. Defaults to `30s`.

config_entries.label: BLE Client ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client/) connected to the unit.

config_entries.label: Time ID
config_entries.description: A [Time](https://esphome.io/components/time/) component to set the unit's clock from. The clock is written once the time is known after each connection, and again whenever the time source syncs.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.
